name: Getting Rich
overview: Scripture teaches that getting rich is ultimately empowered by the LORD, who grants the ability to acquire wealth as part of His covenant faithfulness (Deuteronomy 8:18). True riches come as a blessing from God and bring no sorrow, contrasting with wealth gained by vanity which is unstable and fleeting (Proverbs 10:22; 13:11). The wise manage their resources carefully, preserving and increasing wealth through diligent labor and prudent stewardship, while the foolish squander what they have (Proverbs 13:11; 21:20). Additionally, wealth carries responsibility, as it can influence authority and relationships, and a godly legacy involves leaving an inheritance for future generations (Proverbs 13:22; 22:7).
